explanation: Does every finite abelian group G contain a Sidon set of size 0.01√|G|? The docstring correctly notes that Green's literal definition (r_A ≤ 1) would make this trivially false in exponent-2 groups. It therefore uses the Babai–Sós notion, which permits a + a = b + b. That is a well-justified choice that preserves the intended difficulty. The statement is faithful to the intended question.
